_doc: Matcha drink types for the social graphics (tools/social/drinks.js). A menu_matcha drink name is read top to bottom: the first type whose `words` regex matches it wins; a name that matches none gets the plain `matcha` glyph. `skip` drops menu lines that are not drinks to pour (merch, powders, page furniture, policies) and `strip` cleans the name for display without changing its words. Edit here; tests are test/social-drinks.test.js.
